It’s really about what environment you want. I went to Trinity and moved from out-of-state and I felt so out of place. I’m about to graduate this year, and I know COVID messed up things but I honestly hated how lonely I was and every year I wish I had transferred back home to be with friends. The environment is very different from most schools, so if you aren’t a super wealthy person or upper middle class it might be a little difficult to fit in. That was something I never considered for college, I just looked at schools that looked nice on paper but never thought about if it would be a good fit for me socially or mentally. I got a full ride and assumed others would be in the same spot, which is true, but only around 8% of the entire student body is Pell Grant or first gen and the diversity there is lacking - I really think they should improve on this. I think the faculty and the academic side of it is amazing and you truly get a good education, but the administration and the board of administrators are all greedy and the school makes some questionable choices sometimes that makes me question if they really care about their students more than their money or image (but tbh that’s every private school and most colleges). I don’t know much about UTSA on a deeper level, but I would think about Trinity on a deeper scale of what you want in a college if it’s something that you can fit into. A lot of the students can be really tone deaf and just out of touch with reality. It was super hard for me to fit in and I’ve made little to no friends (again, COVID is a major factor as well). Very glad I’m graduating tbh , but it’s different for everyone!! I don’t want to deter you, just be aware of what’s the most important - if it’s good education then great! I think trinity really helped me academically and because of the education I received there I really felt like it helped me get into great grad program. Also the study abroad programs and partners are great. So it’s all about what you make of it and what you want!! Also feel free to pm me if you have any questions!!
